race.description: Rural City Of Murray Bridge Hcp (Bm80)
race.comment: GIGGENBACH (6) was rewarded for consistency with a tidy win over 1956m at Morphettville Parks last start, easily defeating some of today's key rivals. Now has three wins from six at or around this distance. Well in after the claim and can certainly make it two on the trot. GURU WARRIOR (4) came from well back on the corner to finish third but was no match for GIGGENBACH a fortnight ago. Boasts an excellent record at this trip and he should be at his peak now after four runs back from a spell. ROYAL MILE (5) stepped up sharply in trip to 2525m at Morphettville recently and struggled. Gets a little weight relief and is far more at home over today's journey. TYUSIX (8) chased hard but finished 1.5 lengths off GIGGENBACH when they clashed two weeks ago. The claim brings this honest mare right into calculations. TALISAY (9) is up in grade on his last start win over 1800m at Morphettville. Worth including with no weight on his back.
